title: Counter Card: What Each Northbeam Renew Trade-In Programme Requires Before a Device Changes Hands
content:
Whether photographic identity is checked, the least age at which a customer may trade a device in, whether the trade must be set against a purchase and within how many days either side, whether a signed asset list must be on file and the least number of devices a bulk agreement is written for are all requirements of the Northbeam Renew Trade-In programme the agreement is written under.

| Renew programme | Photographic identity checked | Least age | Trade set against a purchase | Days either side for the linked purchase | Signed asset list required | Least devices a bulk agreement is written for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Renew Instant Store Quote | yes | 18 | no | 0 | no | 0 |
| Renew Mail In Appraisal | no | 18 | no | 0 | no | 0 |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month | yes | 18 | yes | 30 | no | 0 |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month | yes | 18 | yes | 30 | no | 0 |
| Renew Business Asset Buyback | yes | 18 | no | 0 | yes | 5 |
| Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement | yes | 18 | no | 0 | yes | 25 |

Reading the card.

- The least age is 18 on all six programmes.
- A linked purchase is required only on the two trade-up programmes, and the window is 30 days either side of the trade-in on both.
- A signed asset list, and a floor on the number of devices, belong to the two business programmes only; the floor is 5 devices on Renew Business Asset Buyback and 25 on Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement.
- Renew Mail In Appraisal is the one programme on which photographic identity is not checked, the device arriving by post rather than over the counter.
